# Tooling

> Tooling is a command-line tool for syncing configuration between machines.

This file helps language models find the right documentation.

## Docs

- [Install](https://tooling.example/docs/install): install script, package managers, pinning a version
- [Configuration](https://tooling.example/docs/config): the config file and its keys
- [API](https://tooling.example/docs/api): the HTTP API and authentication
